column1: # LearnerSlips cases: sentence<TAB>expected slips as said>fixed, comma-separated (empty = none).
# Read by LearnerSlipsTest and by aaai27 learner_slips.py --self-test, so the probe's copy of the
# rules is checked against the same table.
시장에 사람이 정말 많았고 우리는 시장에 떡볶이 먹었어요.
다음 주에 친구랑 또 시장에 가고 싶어요
공원에 사람이 많고 우리는 떡볶이를 먹었어요
# Right as they are (architect review 2026-10-17): 에 opens or belongs to another clause, or names
# where something ends up, or who is told.
친구 집에 놀러 가서 게임을 했어요
# Right as they are (second architect review 2026-10-17): a verb form that looks like an allowed word.
집에 친구를 데려와 같이 게임을 했어요
# Still slips after those changes: the allowed words themselves.
# Right as they are (third architect review 2026-10-17): a connective with a particle, 와 after a
# verb, an object 에 belongs to, a purpose clause run in by the transcript, a noun fragment.
학교에 도시락을 싸와 친구랑 같이 먹었어요
# Still slips: a particle on the bare noun, 와 after a person, an action noun with 하다.
